description: Canonical profit-factor registry. Single source of truth for PF/WR. Deduplicates signal re-emissions and flags resolver spot-flicker artifacts. Consumers should READ this instead of recomputing PF.

source_files.note: set PF_REGISTRY_INCLUDE_DB=1 to merge MySQL cohort
set PF_REGISTRY_INCLUDE_TOURNAMENT_DB=1 to merge AI-tournament cohort (40 models, ~1.6k resolved trades)

methodology.spot_flicker_rule: non-crypto closed pick with abs(pnl_pct) below threshold is dropped as resolver spot-flicker artifact
methodology.profit_factor: gross_profit / gross_loss (loss magnitude); null when gross_loss == 0

promotion_note: P1-A (2026-06-12): pf_registry WR/PF is discovery-only unless PF_REGISTRY_PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE=1 AND intrabar_truth corroborates (n>=30).
